title: hackersGuild
tagline: One place for hackers and hackathon projects.
description: hackersGuild is a curation of the best new products, everyday built by hackers in various hackathons. Discover the latest web3 technology, products that everyone’s talking about. Users can upvote their favourite projects, support their fav builders by contributing / donating to them using crypto. In short it's Product Hunt on web3. Every project that's been highly voted will be ranked top on the list, Investors , other fellow builders can take inspiration, ideas nd a lot more nd also help contributing to builders by donating to them.
how_its_made:
There were a lot of challenges that I went into building this
1. Internet / Wifi Sucks , My Build crashed almost 5 times
2. Had to download some modules / packages for my project, it was taking a lot of time to install them as internet was too slow, used my mobile data almost full internet wiped out, nd sometimes the download had stopped due to the slow network
3. Designed Frontend in Figma, but couldn't implement it in the main website coz of react delayed installing some of packages, had a lot of ideaas to implement
